terms.comment: The spoken way to say it: jam aderō, I’ll be there in a moment (Ter. Eun. 4.6.26, Lewis & Short; see coming); jam hīc erō, I’ll be back in a moment. Mōmentō temporis is the narrator’s phrase (Liv. 21.33, Lewis & Short).

sources: Lewis & Short: momentum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 87–88.
Lewis & Short: jam. Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-plautus, loci-terentius), checked against the editions named there.

phrases.latin: cūrā, ego ad forum modo ībō: jam hīc erō. — Bene ambulā.
phrases.english: Look after things; I’m just going to the forum: I’ll be back in a moment. — Have a good walk.
